target_audience: Developers who write code daily but have little or no experience with AI-assisted workflows.

chapters.title: The Evolution of Software Development
chapters.description: Explore the shift from manual coding to AI agent management and define new human-AI responsibilities.

chapters.title: How LLMs Understand Code
chapters.description: Learn about tokens, context windows, and why Claude might hallucinate code.

chapters.title: AI Coding Workflow
chapters.description: Transition from the traditional dev loop to the AI-era loop of planning, implementation, and human approval.

chapters.title: Prompting for Developers
chapters.description: Master task, role, and constraint-driven prompts to generate production-ready code with Claude.

chapters.title: Context Engineering
chapters.description: Learn to use memory files and project knowledge to provide Claude with the right technical context.

chapters.title: Long Task Decomposition
chapters.description: Break down complex SaaS requirements into manageable architectural and implementation steps for AI.

chapters.title: Frontend Development
chapters.description: Build modern UIs using React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS assisted by Claude.

chapters.title: Backend Development
chapters.description: Develop robust APIs using FastAPI, Node.js, or Spring Boot with AI assistance.

chapters.title: Database Design
chapters.description: Use Claude as a database architect to design schemas, write migrations, and optimize queries.

chapters.title: Testing and Debugging
chapters.description: Automate unit, integration, and regression tests while using AI for root cause analysis.

chapters.title: Tool Calling
chapters.description: Implement function calling and structured outputs to allow Claude to execute real-world actions.

chapters.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
chapters.description: Connect Claude to external systems using MCP servers, resources, and tools.

chapters.title: Multi-Agent Systems
chapters.description: Design a collaborative workflow featuring Planner, Worker, and Reviewer agents.

chapters.title: Coding Agents
chapters.description: Analyze the internal mechanics of tools like Claude Code and Cursor Agent.

chapters.title: Build a SaaS Application
chapters.description: Apply AI workflows to build a full-stack app with Auth, Billing, and a Dashboard.

chapters.title: Build an AI Chat App
chapters.description: Implement a chat application featuring streaming, memory, and RAG.

chapters.title: Build an Agent Platform
chapters.description: Create a platform with a workflow engine, tool execution, and knowledge base.

chapters.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
chapters.description: Implement chunking, embeddings, and re-ranking to give Claude access to private data.

chapters.title: Context Engineering at Scale
chapters.description: Manage million-token projects using summarization and compression techniques.

chapters.title: Coding Agent Architecture
chapters.description: Design the core components of a coding agent: Planner, Memory, and Tool Executor.

chapters.title: Enterprise AI Development
chapters.description: Address cost optimization, security auditing, and private deployment of AI tools.

chapters.title: Graduation Project: Build Your Own AI Coding Agent
chapters.description: Build a simplified Claude Code clone with CLI, Git integration, and self-review capabilities.
